mentions.name: whenever.world
mentions.description: This is an explorable database of films, TV shows, books and board games organized by their historical setting, letting users explore works by where and when they are set. It involves cleaning up messy data and designing a UI for exploring it.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://whenever.world/

It's an explorable database of films, TV shows, books and board games based around their historical setting: where and when the thing is set. It's been incredibly complex and interesting getting the (messy) data, making sense of it and trying to design a UI to explore it.
